purpose: Restore RapidOCR (default OCR engine) of ChatBot5400 v1.2.0 offline after the application container is recreated (RB-1, D-32). TEST ARTIFACT - Local acceptance only; official integration by Codex.

baseline.note: test image built locally from f2fdf27; the production image has another ID

runtime.installed_from: uv cache on the data volume (/app/data/.cache/uv) by the v1.2.0 entrypoint, constraints /app/runtime-constraints.txt (rapidocr==3.9.2, torch==2.14.0, docling==2.129.0)
runtime.dictionary_path_rule: rapidocr.ch_ppocr_rec.main.DEFAULT_MODEL_PATH / basename(dict_url) - independent of Global.model_root_dir; downloaded with sha256=None when missing

recognition_model.location: Global.model_root_dir = <OCR models dir>/rapidocr (OCR_RAPIDOCR_PERSISTENT=true, data volume) - not restored by this asset set, verified only

dictionary.encoding: UTF-8 text, one character per line

official_checksum.from: ModelScope repo file listing API, model RapidAI/RapidOCR, Revision=v3.9.2 (provenance/official-download/modelscope-file-listing.json)

dictionary.independent_copy: downloaded by RapidOCR itself into the 12E2 baseline container layer when it was online: identical bytes (provenance/from-12e2-baseline-container)
dictionary.rapidocr_yaml_checksum: none (RapidOCR 3.9.2 downloads the dictionary with sha256=None)
dictionary.license: Apache License 2.0 (ModelScope model RapidAI/RapidOCR metadata; rapidocr 3.9.2 package metadata License: Apache-2.0); redistribution allowed with the license notice

other_runtime_files_checked.package_onnx_models: PP-OCRv6_det_small.onnx, PP-OCRv6_rec_small.onnx, ch_ppocr_mobile_v2.0_cls_mobile.onnx: shipped in the rapidocr wheel (uv cache), present after every reinstall
other_runtime_files_checked.torch_weights: on the data volume (model_root_dir), SHA-256 checked by RapidOCR against default_models.yaml
other_runtime_files_checked.docling_layout_tableformer: Hugging Face cache on the data volume (HF_HOME)
other_runtime_files_checked.layer_diff_of_online_12e2_container: only ppocrv6_dict.txt was downloaded into the RapidOCR package dir; /root/.EasyOCR/user_network (empty dir) created by EasyOCR
